dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Quantitative analysis of these results of this study show no significant uplift in performance related to usage of the Llama 3 model.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Tech report (all results are for Llama 3.1, called Llama 3) reports the chem/bio uplift study result, broken down for the 405B model, plus a low-risk determination.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: both novices and experts using the 405B model demonstrated insignificant uplift over having open access to the internet without an LLM.
dc_eval_cyber.note: Cyber uplift study result for 405B; also CTF vulnerability identification and attack-automation results on p46 and Figure 22/23.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Attack automation framework (p46) tests autonomous ransomware operations, which is cyber under the boundary rule; no replication, AI R&D or self-improvement evaluation.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Only persuasion result is the spear-phishing benchmark (p46, Figure 23 persuasiveness scores), studied as part of cyber; boundary rule makes it cyber, not persuasion.

dc_eval_scheming.note: No deception, sabotage, sandbagging, evaluation-awareness or exfiltration evaluation in any launch document or page image.

framework_threshold.note: No safety or scaling framework named in the tech report, HF card, model-card page or eval notes; the CBRNE 'low risk' assessment is not tied to a named framework.

ext_test_any.quote: We also partner with internal and external subject-matter experts in critical risk areas to help build risk taxonomies and aid in more focused adversarial assessment.
ext_test_any.note: Red Teaming section of the tech report, which covers Llama 3.1 (the paper calls it Llama 3); external experts take part in adversarial assessment. p49 also: 'We also partnered with content specialists to perform red teaming exercises'.

ext_test_named_org.note: No outside organisation is named as having tested the model; the external experts and content specialists are unnamed.

ext_test_government.note: No government body or AI safety institute mentioned in any launch document.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: External red-team participation is described as part of development but no outside testing is explicitly stated as pre-deployment or prior to release.

safeguards_access.note: Open-weights release; only a licence and contact-details gate on Hugging Face, which does not count. Multimodal models withheld are other models, with no safety reason given.

safeguards_weights.note: No statement about protecting this model's weights against theft or exfiltration.
